ticks.note: The button goes down. For `Toggle` `button` is true; for `EdgeToggle` it is a rising edge, `button && !pre(button)`. Both go from `Off` to `On`: the light is on.
The button is still held. `Toggle` sees `button` true in `On` and goes straight back to `Off`. `EdgeToggle` sees `pre(button)` true: no edge, so it stays `On`.
Still held: `Toggle` flips back to `On`, and will flicker for as long as the button is held. `EdgeToggle` still sees no edge.
Released. Neither chart reacts to a falling button. `Toggle`'s light is wherever the flicker left it, here on.
A new press, a new rising edge: both charts go from `On` to `Off`.
Released. `EdgeToggle` toggled exactly once per press.
